inj.note: Thomas exited Sunday's contest in the fourth quarter for a concussion check but was able to pass all testing. However, Thomas didn't re-enter the contest in what Harbaugh called a "coach's decision," with the Giants instead using rookie J.C. Davis at left tackle down the stretch. Thomas had been slowed by a groin injury leading up to the game, so that may have been a factor in Harbaugh's decision to keep him on the sideline for the rest of the contest. The 27-year-old should be ready to start in next Sunday's game at Houston.
